name: serde_yaml
input_api: serde_yaml::from_str::<serde_yaml::Value>(&str) -> Result<Value, Error>; Value::{Null, Bool, Number, String, Sequence, Mapping, Tagged}
scope: One YAML document from locally decoded UTF-8 text into serde_yaml's untyped Value tree: mappings in source order (IndexMap), sequences, strings, i64/u64/f64 numbers, booleans and null, with aliases expanded by serde_yaml's loader. Explicit tags, non-string keys and multi-document streams are outside the controls.
family: libyaml (via unsafe-libyaml 0.2.11, a c2rust translation of libyaml at upstream commit 2c891fc7): unsafe-libyaml scans and parses events; serde_yaml adds its own event loader, alias expansion, plain-scalar resolution and Value deserializer. Shared libyaml family with C libyaml, PyYAML's CLoader and PHP ext-yaml.
maintenance: Final release; upstream archived (version suffix +deprecated). serde_yml and serde_norway are forks recorded as shared-family leads.

name: unsafe-libyaml
input_api: unsafe_libyaml::{yaml_parser_initialize, yaml_parser_set_input_string(*mut yaml_parser_t, *const u8, u64), yaml_parser_load(*mut yaml_parser_t, *mut yaml_document_t) -> Success, yaml_document_get_root_node, yaml_document_get_node, yaml_document_delete, yaml_parser_delete}; yaml_node_t scalar (value, length, style), sequence items and mapping pairs
scope: One YAML document from local UTF-8 bytes composed by unsafe-libyaml's loader (yaml_parser_load) into a yaml_document_t node graph; aliases point at the anchored node, so the harness walk expands them. libyaml does not resolve plain scalars: the harness types them with the YAML 1.2 core-schema patterns (null, bool, int, float, otherwise str), exactly as the C libyaml harness does, and every quoted or block scalar is a str. A second yaml_parser_load must return an empty document. Explicit tags, non-scalar keys and multi-document streams are outside the controls.
family: libyaml: unsafe-libyaml 0.2.11 is a c2rust translation of libyaml at upstream commit 2c891fc7 and is the same crate the selected serde_yaml path drives (serde_yaml uses its yaml_parser_parse event interface with its own loader; this path uses libyaml's own yaml_parser_load composer). Shared libyaml family with serde_yaml, C libyaml, PyYAML's CLoader and PHP ext-yaml.
maintenance: Upstream repository archived by its author; libyaml-rs (YAML organization) and unsafe-libyaml-norway are forks whose library sources differ only by lint attributes and pointer-syntax rewrites.

name: yaml-rust
input_api: yaml_rust::YamlLoader::load_from_str(&str) -> Result<Vec<Yaml>, ScanError>; Yaml::{Real, Integer, String, Boolean, Array, Hash, Alias, Null, BadValue}
scope: One YAML document from locally decoded UTF-8 text into yaml-rust's Yaml tree: Hash (LinkedHashMap, source order), Array, String, Integer (i64), Real (kept as source text; parsed to f64 by the harness with Yaml::as_f64), Boolean and Null, with aliases replaced by the anchored node in the loader. The loader must return exactly one document.
family: yaml-rust (own pure-Rust scanner, parser and loader, a port of libyaml's design without shared code); yaml-rust2 and saphyr continue this code base and are separate leads of the same lineage.
maintenance: Unmaintained upstream since 2020 (RUSTSEC-2024-0320 unmaintained advisory); yaml-rust2 is the maintained fork.

name: yaml-rust2
input_api: yaml_rust2::YamlLoader::load_from_str(&str) -> Result<Vec<Yaml>, ScanError>; Yaml::{Real, Integer, String, Boolean, Array, Hash, Alias, Null, BadValue}
scope: One YAML document from locally decoded UTF-8 text into yaml-rust2's Yaml tree: Hash (hashlink LinkedHashMap, source order), Array, String, Integer (i64), Real (kept as source text; parsed to f64 by the harness with Yaml::as_f64), Boolean and Null, with aliases replaced by the anchored node in the loader. Explicit tags, non-string keys and multi-document streams are outside the controls.
family: yaml-rust lineage: yaml-rust2 is the maintained fork of the selected yaml-rust (README: 'based on yaml-rust with fixes towards being compliant to the YAML test suite'). 708 of its 1,914 distinct non-test source lines longer than 25 characters also occur in yaml-rust 0.4.5 (37.0%; 63.2% of yaml-rust's 1,121). saphyr and saphyr-parser continue it.
maintenance: README: basic maintenance with a stable API; new features go to saphyr.

name: serde-saphyr
input_api: serde_saphyr::from_str::<T: Deserialize>(&str) -> Result<T, Error>, here with a harness Deserialize type whose visitor uses deserialize_any (visit_bool/i64/u64/f64/str/unit/seq/map)
scope: One YAML document from locally decoded UTF-8 text deserialized by serde-saphyr into the harness's order-keeping Deserialize type: serde-saphyr has no Value type of its own, so a deserialize_any visitor records maps in event order, sequences, and the scalar kinds serde-saphyr resolves (bool, i64/u64, f64, null, otherwise str; quoted and block scalars stay str). serde-saphyr replays aliases itself. Explicit tags, non-string keys and multi-document streams are outside the controls.
family: granit-parser / yaml-rust lineage: serde-saphyr 2.x drives granit-parser 2.2.0 (the same author's fork of saphyr-parser) for events and adds its own deserializer, anchor replay and scalar resolution (38 of its 14,737 distinct non-test source lines longer than 25 characters also occur in granit-parser).

name: granit-parser
input_api: granit_parser::Parser::new_from_str(&str) and Parser::next_event() -> Option<Result<(Event, Span), ScanError>>; Event::{StreamStart, DocumentStart, Scalar(text, ScalarStyle, anchor_id, tag), SequenceStart, MappingStart, Alias(anchor_id), ...}
scope: One YAML document from locally decoded UTF-8 text as a granit-parser event stream; the harness assembles the typed tree in event order, copies the anchored node for each Alias event, skips Comment and Anchor metadata events, and types plain scalars with the YAML 1.2 core-schema patterns (null, bool, int, float, otherwise str) as the C and C++ YAML harnesses do; quoted and block scalars are str. Explicit tags, non-scalar keys and multi-document streams are outside the controls.
family: yaml-rust lineage: granit-parser started as a fork of saphyr-parser and is maintained independently (README); 1,125 of its 5,855 distinct non-test source lines longer than 25 characters also occur in saphyr-parser 0.3.4 (19.2%; 59.6% of saphyr-parser's 1,889). It is the event parser under the selected serde-saphyr.

name: saphyr-parser
input_api: saphyr_parser::Parser::new_from_str(&str) and Parser::next_event() -> Option<Result<(Event, Span), ScanError>>; Event::{StreamStart, DocumentStart, Scalar(text, ScalarStyle, anchor_id, tag), SequenceStart, MappingStart, Alias(anchor_id), ...}
scope: One YAML document from locally decoded UTF-8 text as a saphyr-parser event stream; the harness assembles the typed tree in event order, copies the anchored node for each Alias event, and types plain scalars with the YAML 1.2 core-schema patterns (null, bool, int, float, otherwise str) as the C and C++ YAML harnesses do; quoted and block scalars are str. Explicit tags, non-scalar keys and multi-document streams are outside the controls.
family: yaml-rust lineage: saphyr-parser is the parser half of the saphyr-rs project, which continues yaml-rust2; 965 of its 1,889 distinct non-test source lines longer than 25 characters also occur in yaml-rust2 0.13.0 (51.1%) and 348 in yaml-rust 0.4.5 (18.4%).
maintenance: Actively released by the saphyr-rs project.

name: saphyr
input_api: saphyr::Yaml::load_from_str(&str) -> Result<Vec<Yaml>, ScanError> (LoadableYamlNode); Yaml::{Value(Scalar::{Null, Boolean, Integer, FloatingPoint, String}), Sequence, Mapping, Tagged, Representation, Alias, BadValue}
scope: One YAML document from locally decoded UTF-8 text into saphyr's Yaml tree: Mapping (hashlink LinkedHashMap, source order), Sequence, and Scalar values that saphyr's loader resolves itself (Null, Boolean, Integer i64, FloatingPoint f64, String), with aliases replaced by a copy of the anchored node. Explicit tags, non-string keys and multi-document streams are outside the controls.
family: yaml-rust lineage: saphyr is the loader half of the saphyr-rs project that continues yaml-rust2; it drives the selected saphyr-parser 0.3.4 for events and adds its own loader, scalar resolution and Yaml tree (265 of its 1,663 distinct non-test source lines longer than 25 characters also occur in yaml-rust2 0.13.0, 15.9%).
maintenance: Actively released by the saphyr-rs project.

name: noyalib
input_api: noyalib::from_str::<noyalib::Value>(&str) -> Result<Value, Error>; Value::{Null, Bool, Number(Number::{Integer, Float}), String, Sequence, Mapping, Tagged}
scope: One YAML document from locally decoded UTF-8 text into noyalib's Value tree with default features: Mapping (IndexMap with String keys, source order), Sequence, String, i64 and f64 numbers, booleans and null, with aliases expanded by noyalib's loader. Explicit tags and multi-document streams are outside the controls.
family: noyalib: own pure-Rust scanner, parser and loader (forbid(unsafe_code)); at most 187 of its 23,954 distinct non-test source lines longer than 25 characters also occur in serde_yaml (0.8%) and 40 in yaml-rust2. serde_yml 0.0.13 only re-exports its serde_yaml compatibility module.

name: dbt-yaml
input_api: dbt_yaml::from_str::<dbt_yaml::Value>(&str) -> Result<Value, Error>; Value::{Null, Bool, Number, String, Sequence, Mapping, Tagged}, each with a Span
scope: One YAML document from locally decoded UTF-8 text into dbt-yaml's span-carrying Value tree with default features: mappings in source order (IndexMap), sequences, strings, i64/u64/f64 numbers, booleans and null, with aliases expanded by dbt-yaml's loader; spans are ignored. Explicit tags, non-string keys and multi-document streams are outside the controls.
family: libyaml (via unsafe-libyaml 0.2.11, the same crate as the selected serde_yaml and unsafe-libyaml paths): dbt-yaml is dbt Labs' fork of serde_yaml with spans, verbatim strings and a reworked Value deserializer; 2,561 of its 5,151 distinct non-test source lines longer than 25 characters also occur in serde_yaml 0.9.34 (49.7%).
maintenance: Fork of serde_yaml maintained by dbt Labs; actively released. The published crate ships no license files (license from Cargo.toml and the crates.io record).
